message:
it's 3pm on a monday, perfect time to be in [canggu](kebi://area/id/bali/canggu). here's how i'd play the afternoon:

[The Lawn Canggu](kebi://venue/3dbb0a08-bd83-40b0-b581-5a87a76a611f) is the anchor. it's right on the water, 3pm is the sweet spot before the sunset crowd arrives, and given you're into waterfront spots with a bit of energy, this is the one. grab a sunbed, get a drink in hand, and let the afternoon run.

if you want to build it into more of a crawl, start at [Batu Bolong Beach](kebi://venue/7872c6f9-ef30-4d0b-b8a8-828b35e6e063) for a walk along the [sand](kebi://venue/f01f4435-631c-41e9-a3a9-f05356eb82c2), then drift into [Old Man's](kebi://venue/45a09352-bfd6-403a-b5c5-7b23699a1ce2) right there on batu bolong. it runs every day, classic laid-back beach bar energy, good for an easy early drink.

[Finns Beach Club](kebi://venue/c61dd547-cc0d-452a-a5d2-f13d3751d1c6) over in [Berawa](kebi://venue/ab4e902c-e127-4cc3-868f-754fd5a5240a) is the bigger production if you want the full resort experience, pools, DJs, the works. open every day, and it's a proper afternoon-into-evening spot.

and if you want to keep going after sunset, Sand Bar does afterparties every night so that's an easy end to the day.

going afternoon only or rolling it into a night out? that changes which one to anchor around.
